From: Elena Petrova <elena@orbitsoft.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 08:21:00 -0500
Subject: OrbitSoft pilot: ask for extra credits + extension

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood’s latency and cost profiles. We’re close to a pilot go/no-go but procurement has dragged and we’ve lost two weeks. Our timeline is tight: we need an additional 30k free inference credits to get through the expanded test cases and another two-week trial extension so we can complete a final security pass and procurement sign-off.

Our standard trial credit is 10k; to validate our LLM flows across two regions we’ll need ~40k total. I realize this is beyond standard, so can you escalate for an exception? If you need an estimated renewal or commit, we can discuss a 12-month minimum commit contingent on pilot outcomes.

Attached is our brief SOW and a summary of the new test cases.

Best,
Elena Petrova
Head of Data Platform
OrbitSoft

Attachments: orbitsoft_sow_draft.pdf (doc stub)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the context and the SOW; I’ve reviewed it with Diego (solutions) and we’re aligned on the technical scope. I can extend the trial by two weeks immediately. The 30k additional credits you’re asking for exceeds our standard onetime top-up. I’ll escalate for a one-time credit top-up + a small promotional discount against the first month of committed usage.

Two quick asks so I can build the case:
- Can you confirm the expected monthly token usage if you convert from pilot to production (ballpark)?
- Would OrbitSoft be willing to consider a 12-month minimum commit if we provide the extra credits and a 10% first-year discount?

I’ll route this to Markus and Marissa for exec/finance signoff — copying them now. I’ll come back with the final terms within 24–48 hours.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman

Hi Markus / Marissa —

Forwarding OrbitSoft’s request. TL;DR: they want a 2-week trial extension (we can do this immediately) plus a one-time top-up of 30k free inference credits (standard is 10k). They’re open to a 12-month commit if we provide credits + a promotional discount on month 1.

Why I’m escalating:
- The ask (30k) drives ~40% of the estimated pilot consumption and is outside our normal SDR-approved ranges.
- OrbitSoft is EU-based, high signal (well-funded, strong engineering team), and this deal could convert quickly if they pass security/procurement.
- Sales engineer Diego validated the SOW and says there’s minimal infra risk; token profile is normal.

Proposed approval package (what I’m asking for):
1) One-time credit top-up: 20k additional free inference credits (bringing total to 30k) — REQUESTED
2) Trial extension: 2 weeks — APPROVE NOW (ops can extend)
3) Promotional concession: 10% off month 1 of committed usage OR a $10k promo credit applied to the first invoice — conditional on a 12-month minimum commit to be signed within 60 days

Attachments included for your review: credit_calculation.xlsx, proposed_quote_ORBIT-1492.pdf

If approved, I’ll finalize the quote and route DocuSign to OrbitSoft procurement. If you prefer tighter guardrails, I’m happy to reduce the credit top-up and require a 3-month evaluation milestone.

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply given procurement timelines.

—Aisha
